publicV1.reason: Thirteen local restatements of shared types are replaced by imports of the declarations they restate. No /v1 operation, request or response schema, status code or error body changes; the wire shapes were already what the contract describes.

mcp.reason: No MCP tool, argument, result shape, registration or transport behaviour is touched.

openapi.reason: The document projects the operation registry; converging duplicate declarations does not alter a registered schema.

apiPlayground.reason: The playground reads the same unchanged registry.

internalOnly.reason: Removes 13 duplicate declarations across apps/api, apps/web and packages/sandbox-environment; adds type-only imports in packages/sandbox-core plus a parity gate for its runtime family array; reconciles two already-drifted pairs (the SMTP read body and the /runtimes envelope) where the declaration and the bytes already contradicted each other; adds a build gate failing on an unimported contracts export.
